bug_info.bug_desc: In flash_mp, region_match was computed without checking region_cfgs_i[i].en.q. As a result, disabled regions still participated in the priority-based region selection. Since the lowest-index matching region has priority, a disabled low-index region could be selected over a higher-index enabled region or the default region. The selected disabled region then produced no read/program/page-erase enable, so the request was treated as erroneous even though a higher-priority enabled region (or default region) should have matched instead.
bug_info.fix_hint: Qualify the region_match computation with region_cfgs_i[i].en.q so disabled regions do not match and cannot occupy priority selection. Because region_sel now only selects enabled regions, the en.q checks in rd_en, prog_en, and pg_erase_en are redundant and can be removed, leaving permission qualifiers and region_sel.
